title: InventoryStopChanged v1 payload
description: A stop on a dish was made, revised, lifted or expired (ADR 0141). Symmetric by construction: active carries the direction, so a dish going on stop and coming back are the same event type. A stop has a scope (LOCATION, BRAND, MENU or CHANNEL), a source (OPERATOR, BOT or POS; KITCHEN_DEVICE and RULE are reserved) and an optional end. Identifiers and stable codes only: never a product or variant name, never free text, never personal data (ADR 0029). reasonCode is a short enumerated code. locationId is present for a LOCATION stop and for a CHANNEL stop at one branch; menuId only for MENU; channelId only for CHANNEL. A consumer resolves names through the authorized catalog API with variantId.
